settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Everything in one place — your account and your workspace. Pick a section to manage it.

security.title: Login & security

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Sign out of every device where you're logged in — including this one. Useful if you lost a laptop or shared your password.
sessions.signOutAllConfirmDesc: Every device logged into this account will be signed out and will need to log in again. You will be redirected to the login page.
